data.standardized_narrative: During 2017 the Syndicate reported a net release from prior year reserves driven by favourable claims development (a reported release of GBP 59.2m). Offsetting this, a regulatory change to the Ogden discount rate caused a GBP 52.4m strengthening of reserves for 2014 and prior motor treaty business. The year was also materially impacted by an aggregate of GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses (hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Nate; Mexico City earthquake; Northern and Southern California wildfires) which affected current year underwriting.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: the report explicitly states a release of GBP 59.2m (text) but does not present a single explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision' line. The GBP 59.2m is reported in narrative (likely net of reinsurance in many reports) and has been used because no clear gross prior-year movement reconciliation was found. The report does include a specific gross-strengthening figure of GBP 52.4m attributable to the Ogden discount rate change (UK Motor treaty 2014 and prior). The claims development triangle and technical provisions include RITC references (Syndicate 1400 RITC accepted as at 1 January 2016) which can distort triangle-based PYD calculations; as such the net narrative figure was used and the reliance on net figures is noted here.
